name: Treasure Hunter's Gamble

start.dialog: Heard rumors of a phoenix cave in these parts! Ancient treasure! But I hurt my leg getting here. Help me find the entrance? I'll split whatever we find! 50-50! Okay, 60-40! Final offer!
start.objective: Search for the hidden phoenix cave entrance in the desert cliffs

progress.dialog: Any luck? Phoenix caves are usually behind waterfalls or in lava flows! But this is a desert... maybe sandfall?
progress.objective: Continue searching for hidden cave entrances behind sandfalls

complete.dialog: YOU FOUND IT! And look - phoenix downs! These can revive the fallen! Rare stuff! Here's your cut! And take this smoke bomb - great for escaping tight spots!

party_comments.kade: Treasure hunting... never tried it, but it sounds exciting!
party_comments.twist: Phoenix cave?! Can we keep one?!
party_comments.nix7: Phoenix Down: extremely valuable resurrection agent.

hidden_outcome: If you find the secret back entrance, you discover an unlooted chamber with 'Ultimate Weapon' - a rare sword
